screens.prompt:
Flat UI design screenshot of a desktop web app called "JARVIS" (an internal groupware assistant), bento grid style, no device frame, no perspective, straight-on 16:9.

VISUAL STYLE: warm off-white canvas (#F4F1EA), rounded 24px cards in white and soft sage (#DCE5DA) with subtle shadows, deep forest green primary (#1F4D3A), vivid orange accent (#F26B2A) used only for alerts, charcoal text, clean geometric sans-serif, big bold numerals, pill-shaped tabs and buttons, generous spacing, calm premium SaaS look.

LAYOUT:
- Far-left slim vertical navigation rail (white, rounded): small dark-green logo square with letter "J" at top, then icon+label items "Home", "Timesheets" (active, dark green pill), spacer, then "Admin" (shield icon) and "Settings" (gear icon) near the bottom, round user avatar at the very bottom.
- Top header: page title "Timesheets", date chip "Mon 16 Nov 2026 · W47", pill tab bar: "Daily Log" (active), "Weekly Plan", "Group Timesheet", "Projects", "Leave". Right side buttons: "Import .xlsx" (outline) and "Export .xlsx" (dark green).
- Big left card (60% width) titled "30-min Log": spreadsheet-like grid with rows 07:30, 08:00, 08:30, 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00. Columns: Time | Category | Task | Focus. Category cells are small colored pills: "General" (blue), "Meeting" (yellow), "Work Lamp" (light blue), "Lunch" (grey). Task text like "Email & admin", "Daily scrum", "Dev | Work lamp housing". Focus column shows 3 small dots.
- Right column of stacked bento cards:
  1) "Today" card: huge numeral "8h 30m" with a small donut chart (green, blue, yellow, light blue segments) and legend.
  2) Orange alert card: "2 new group projects detected" with two rows "P-2071 Marine Flood Light" and "P-2078 Trail Beacon Kit" and a white pill button "Map now".
  3) Sage card "AI Assist": sparkle icon, text "Map local alias 'Work Lamp' → P-2041 Utility Work Lamp?" with buttons "Accept" and "Edit".

Crisp legible English text, realistic product UI, low clutter.
